usage.outputShape: body.candidates[0].content.parts[0].inlineData.data (base64-encoded image), with body.candidates[0].content.parts[0].inlineData.mimeType (e.g. image/png) for the type
quirks: Uses Google Gemini-native generateContent request shape, NOT a flat {prompt} field. The prompt text goes at contents[0].parts[0].text.
For image editing/composition add an inlineData part: {parts:[{text:'add a hat'},{inlineData:{mimeType:'image/jpeg',data:'<base64>'}}]} (up to 3 input images).

Set generationConfig.responseModalities to ['IMAGE'] for image-only or ['TEXT','IMAGE'] for both; optional generationConfig.imageConfig.aspectRatio supports 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9.
Output image is returned as base64 inside the JSON body (not a URL); decode parts[].inlineData.data to get the PNG. Response is ~2 MB for a single image.
usage.guide: Text-to-image (and image editing) via Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Image. POST a JSON body shaped {contents:[{parts:[{text:"your prompt"}]}], generationConfig:{responseModalities:["IMAGE"]}} to the URL; pay $0.05 USDC on Base via x402 (no API key). Read the result from body.candidates[0].content.parts[0].inlineData.data, which is a base64-encoded image (check inlineData.mimeType, e.g. image/png) — decode and save it. To edit or compose, add an inlineData part containing a base64 source image (up to 3). Synchronous, returns a 200 with the image inline.
